settings.question: Is there really no subscription?
settings.answer: Correct. You buy the ring once and every metric, trend and export is unlocked permanently. There is no paid tier, and nothing stops working later.

settings.question: Is Aurora a medical device?
settings.answer: No. Aurora is a wellness tracker. It reports trends in sleep, activity and recovery to help you understand your own patterns. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease, and it should never replace advice from a qualified clinician.

settings.question: How do I get the right size?
settings.answer: Every order includes a free sizing kit. Wear the sizer for 24 hours — finger size shifts with temperature and time of day — then confirm your size and we ship the ring.

settings.question: Can I wear it in water?
settings.answer: Yes. Aurora is water-resistant to 100 metres, so showering, swimming and washing up are all fine.

settings.question: What happens to my data?
settings.answer: It stays yours. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, never sold to third parties, and exportable in full at any time. You can delete your account and everything attached to it from within the app.

settings.eyebrow: Why we built it this way
settings.heading: Your body should not be a subscription.
settings.standfirst:
Every tracker we tried did the same thing eventually: measured us accurately, then put the reading behind a monthly fee. Stop paying and years of your own sleep stop being yours to look at.

Aurora exists because that trade is unnecessary. The sensors cost what they cost once. Nothing about reading your own data justifies a bill every month for the rest of your life.
